decisions.record_protection: lay flat on turntable without skipping

commitments.detail: Ensure turntable is centered on coffee table for optimal sound quality.
Handle records gently to prevent damage during playback.
Start event at 7:00 PM on June 15, 2023.
Maintain volume at 80 decibels to ensure comfort for all attendees.
Take a 10-minute break every 30 minutes to discuss tracks and enjoy refreshments.
